MARKET_PLAYER_DIST is reconstructed FROM the Kalshi ladder and the HYBRID arms blend the two: they are reported, flagged `market_derived`, and never promoted into the primary slot. Being primary says nothing about authority: every arm answer carries its production-eligibility status, and on the current evidence the MARKET is the better player-prop distribution.

production_eligibility.how_to_read: TRUSTED may be relied on as primary evidence; LIMITED may inform a handicap beside the market; WATCH is supporting evidence only; RESEARCH_ONLY is displayed and never an input; DISABLED shows no number. Large model-market disagreement is historically where the models are WORST.

-.meaning: outside the pregame window (kickoff has passed)

slate_summary.coverage_contract: RUN NFL examines every executable Kalshi contract for every requested unstarted NFL game. UNSUPPORTED_MODEL is a statement about one model, never a reason to hide a contract. Every listed contract terminates in exactly one analysis state, in one of four buckets: A validated model view, B coherent/Shadow research view, C manual handicap from the packet's own football and context data, D explicit PASS with a named reason.
slate_summary.disclaimer: Priority ranks where deeper review may be most useful. It is NOT a bet ranking and carries no expectation that these games contain value.

simulation.ranking_basis: Only families with a non-zero DEPLOYED reconciliation weight are ranked. At weight 0 the reconciled mean IS the market mean, so any remaining gap against the mid comes from the football shape, which has never been confirmed out of sample; those rows are listed under unranked_zero_weight_disagreements and carry no authority. A row whose reconciled gap points the OPPOSITE way to its own football view is also not ranked -- the relocation crossed the mid, so the gap is the market-mean estimator rather than the model's opinion -- and is listed under earned_but_contradicts_football_view.
simulation.note: The simulation's football-only probability is shown for every priced market; only the RECONCILED probability -- the football distribution shrunk toward the market by a weight fitted out of sample on the 2025 archive -- is ranked, and only where such a weight exists.

shadow_v2.information_sync_default: SYNCHRONIZED -- a market row carries `information_sync` only when it is NOT synchronized, i.e. only when the model read information the market it is quoted against had not yet seen
shadow_v2.primary_arm_basis: BOARD_V2 owns every non-player family; DATA_PLAYER_V3 is the player arm that is an independent football view of the statistic (DATA_PLAYER_DIST, its defective predecessor, is primary only on snapshots written before v3 and is DISABLED). MARKET_PLAYER_DIST is reconstructed FROM the Kalshi ladder and the HYBRID arms blend the two: they are reported, flagged `market_derived`, and never promoted into the primary slot. Being primary says nothing about authority: every arm answer carries its production-eligibility status, and on the current evidence the MARKET is the better player-prop distribution.
shadow_v2.not_in_snapshot_reason: Shadow v2 prices the universe of the latest daily discovery run; a contract Kalshi opened after that run has no v2 row at this snapshot

simulation.distribution_quantiles_note: The football median is the simulation distribution's own quantile(0.50). An artifact written before sim-1.1.0 does not report quantiles at all; those rows say so rather than having a median inferred for them.

coverage.invariant: Every listed FULL-period player/stat group is in exactly one bucket: exposed with its distribution summary, or refused with a reason. silently_missing must be 0.

simulation.ranking_basis: Only families with a non-zero DEPLOYED reconciliation weight are ranked. At weight 0 the reconciled mean IS the market mean, so any remaining gap against the mid comes from the football shape, which has never been confirmed out of sample; those rows are listed under unranked_zero_weight_disagreements and carry no authority. A row whose reconciled gap points the OPPOSITE way to its own football view is also not ranked -- the relocation crossed the mid, so the gap is the market-mean estimator rather than the model's opinion -- and is listed under earned_but_contradicts_football_view.
simulation.note: The simulation's football-only probability is shown for every priced market; only the RECONCILED probability -- the football distribution shrunk toward the market by a weight fitted out of sample on the 2025 archive -- is ranked, and only where such a weight exists.

shadow_v2.information_sync_default: SYNCHRONIZED -- a market row carries `information_sync` only when it is NOT synchronized, i.e. only when the model read information the market it is quoted against had not yet seen
shadow_v2.primary_arm_basis: BOARD_V2 owns every non-player family; DATA_PLAYER_V3 is the player arm that is an independent football view of the statistic (DATA_PLAYER_DIST, its defective predecessor, is primary only on snapshots written before v3 and is DISABLED). MARKET_PLAYER_DIST is reconstructed FROM the Kalshi ladder and the HYBRID arms blend the two: they are reported, flagged `market_derived`, and never promoted into the primary slot. Being primary says nothing about authority: every arm answer carries its production-eligibility status, and on the current evidence the MARKET is the better player-prop distribution.
shadow_v2.not_in_snapshot_reason: Shadow v2 prices the universe of the latest daily discovery run; a contract Kalshi opened after that run has no v2 row at this snapshot

simulation.distribution_quantiles_note: The football median is the simulation distribution's own quantile(0.50). An artifact written before sim-1.1.0 does not report quantiles at all; those rows say so rather than having a median inferred for them.

coverage.invariant: Every listed FULL-period player/stat group is in exactly one bucket: exposed with its distribution summary, or refused with a reason. silently_missing must be 0.

simulation.ranking_basis: Only families with a non-zero DEPLOYED reconciliation weight are ranked. At weight 0 the reconciled mean IS the market mean, so any remaining gap against the mid comes from the football shape, which has never been confirmed out of sample; those rows are listed under unranked_zero_weight_disagreements and carry no authority. A row whose reconciled gap points the OPPOSITE way to its own football view is also not ranked -- the relocation crossed the mid, so the gap is the market-mean estimator rather than the model's opinion -- and is listed under earned_but_contradicts_football_view.
simulation.note: The simulation's football-only probability is shown for every priced market; only the RECONCILED probability -- the football distribution shrunk toward the market by a weight fitted out of sample on the 2025 archive -- is ranked, and only where such a weight exists.

shadow_v2.information_sync_default: SYNCHRONIZED -- a market row carries `information_sync` only when it is NOT synchronized, i.e. only when the model read information the market it is quoted against had not yet seen
shadow_v2.primary_arm_basis: BOARD_V2 owns every non-player family; DATA_PLAYER_V3 is the player arm that is an independent football view of the statistic (DATA_PLAYER_DIST, its defective predecessor, is primary only on snapshots written before v3 and is DISABLED). MARKET_PLAYER_DIST is reconstructed FROM the Kalshi ladder and the HYBRID arms blend the two: they are reported, flagged `market_derived`, and never promoted into the primary slot. Being primary says nothing about authority: every arm answer carries its production-eligibility status, and on the current evidence the MARKET is the better player-prop distribution.
shadow_v2.not_in_snapshot_reason: Shadow v2 prices the universe of the latest daily discovery run; a contract Kalshi opened after that run has no v2 row at this snapshot

simulation.distribution_quantiles_note: The football median is the simulation distribution's own quantile(0.50). An artifact written before sim-1.1.0 does not report quantiles at all; those rows say so rather than having a median inferred for them.

coverage.invariant: Every listed FULL-period player/stat group is in exactly one bucket: exposed with its distribution summary, or refused with a reason. silently_missing must be 0.

simulation.ranking_basis: Only families with a non-zero DEPLOYED reconciliation weight are ranked. At weight 0 the reconciled mean IS the market mean, so any remaining gap against the mid comes from the football shape, which has never been confirmed out of sample; those rows are listed under unranked_zero_weight_disagreements and carry no authority. A row whose reconciled gap points the OPPOSITE way to its own football view is also not ranked -- the relocation crossed the mid, so the gap is the market-mean estimator rather than the model's opinion -- and is listed under earned_but_contradicts_football_view.
simulation.note: The simulation's football-only probability is shown for every priced market; only the RECONCILED probability -- the football distribution shrunk toward the market by a weight fitted out of sample on the 2025 archive -- is ranked, and only where such a weight exists.

shadow_v2.information_sync_default: SYNCHRONIZED -- a market row carries `information_sync` only when it is NOT synchronized, i.e. only when the model read information the market it is quoted against had not yet seen
shadow_v2.primary_arm_basis: BOARD_V2 owns every non-player family; DATA_PLAYER_V3 is the player arm that is an independent football view of the statistic (DATA_PLAYER_DIST, its defective predecessor, is primary only on snapshots written before v3 and is DISABLED). MARKET_PLAYER_DIST is reconstructed FROM the Kalshi ladder and the HYBRID arms blend the two: they are reported, flagged `market_derived`, and never promoted into the primary slot. Being primary says nothing about authority: every arm answer carries its production-eligibility status, and on the current evidence the MARKET is the better player-prop distribution.
shadow_v2.not_in_snapshot_reason: Shadow v2 prices the universe of the latest daily discovery run; a contract Kalshi opened after that run has no v2 row at this snapshot

simulation.distribution_quantiles_note: The football median is the simulation distribution's own quantile(0.50). An artifact written before sim-1.1.0 does not report quantiles at all; those rows say so rather than having a median inferred for them.

coverage.invariant: Every listed FULL-period player/stat group is in exactly one bucket: exposed with its distribution summary, or refused with a reason. silently_missing must be 0.

simulation.ranking_basis: Only families with a non-zero DEPLOYED reconciliation weight are ranked. At weight 0 the reconciled mean IS the market mean, so any remaining gap against the mid comes from the football shape, which has never been confirmed out of sample; those rows are listed under unranked_zero_weight_disagreements and carry no authority. A row whose reconciled gap points the OPPOSITE way to its own football view is also not ranked -- the relocation crossed the mid, so the gap is the market-mean estimator rather than the model's opinion -- and is listed under earned_but_contradicts_football_view.
simulation.note: The simulation's football-only probability is shown for every priced market; only the RECONCILED probability -- the football distribution shrunk toward the market by a weight fitted out of sample on the 2025 archive -- is ranked, and only where such a weight exists.

shadow_v2.information_sync_default: SYNCHRONIZED -- a market row carries `information_sync` only when it is NOT synchronized, i.e. only when the model read information the market it is quoted against had not yet seen
shadow_v2.primary_arm_basis: BOARD_V2 owns every non-player family; DATA_PLAYER_V3 is the player arm that is an independent football view of the statistic (DATA_PLAYER_DIST, its defective predecessor, is primary only on snapshots written before v3 and is DISABLED). MARKET_PLAYER_DIST is reconstructed FROM the Kalshi ladder and the HYBRID arms blend the two: they are reported, flagged `market_derived`, and never promoted into the primary slot. Being primary says nothing about authority: every arm answer carries its production-eligibility status, and on the current evidence the MARKET is the better player-prop distribution.
shadow_v2.not_in_snapshot_reason: Shadow v2 prices the universe of the latest daily discovery run; a contract Kalshi opened after that run has no v2 row at this snapshot

simulation.distribution_quantiles_note: The football median is the simulation distribution's own quantile(0.50). An artifact written before sim-1.1.0 does not report quantiles at all; those rows say so rather than having a median inferred for them.

coverage.invariant: Every listed FULL-period player/stat group is in exactly one bucket: exposed with its distribution summary, or refused with a reason. silently_missing must be 0.

simulation.ranking_basis: Only families with a non-zero DEPLOYED reconciliation weight are ranked. At weight 0 the reconciled mean IS the market mean, so any remaining gap against the mid comes from the football shape, which has never been confirmed out of sample; those rows are listed under unranked_zero_weight_disagreements and carry no authority. A row whose reconciled gap points the OPPOSITE way to its own football view is also not ranked -- the relocation crossed the mid, so the gap is the market-mean estimator rather than the model's opinion -- and is listed under earned_but_contradicts_football_view.
simulation.note: The simulation's football-only probability is shown for every priced market; only the RECONCILED probability -- the football distribution shrunk toward the market by a weight fitted out of sample on the 2025 archive -- is ranked, and only where such a weight exists.

freshness.reason: the simulation priced this packet's own board

shadow_v2.information_sync_default: SYNCHRONIZED -- a market row carries `information_sync` only when it is NOT synchronized, i.e. only when the model read information the market it is quoted against had not yet seen
shadow_v2.primary_arm_basis: BOARD_V2 owns every non-player family; DATA_PLAYER_V3 is the player arm that is an independent football view of the statistic (DATA_PLAYER_DIST, its defective predecessor, is primary only on snapshots written before v3 and is DISABLED). MARKET_PLAYER_DIST is reconstructed FROM the Kalshi ladder and the HYBRID arms blend the two: they are reported, flagged `market_derived`, and never promoted into the primary slot. Being primary says nothing about authority: every arm answer carries its production-eligibility status, and on the current evidence the MARKET is the better player-prop distribution.
shadow_v2.not_in_snapshot_reason: Shadow v2 prices the universe of the latest daily discovery run; a contract Kalshi opened after that run has no v2 row at this snapshot
shadow_v2.authority: RESEARCH ONLY. Shadow v2 is not validated for real money and no probability here reaches recommendation, staking or preflight.

B.meaning: coherent / Shadow research model view available

C.meaning: no automated pricing authority; handicap from the football and context data in this packet

D.meaning: cannot defensibly price -- explicit PASS / RESEARCH REQUIRED, with a reason

-.meaning: outside the pregame window (kickoff has passed)

!.meaning: INVARIANT VIOLATION -- a listed contract with no analysis state

coverage.invariant: silently_omitted must be 0: every listed contract carries exactly one analysis state

disagreement_ranking_basis.note: Markets wider than the cap, and untraded 0.00/0.99 books, are present in `markets` but never ranked -- their midpoint is a quoting artefact. Without this filter the top of every disagreement list is a book nobody has traded.

simulation.distribution_quantiles_note: The football median is the simulation distribution's own quantile(0.50). An artifact written before sim-1.1.0 does not report quantiles at all; those rows say so rather than having a median inferred for them.

coverage.invariant: Every listed FULL-period player/stat group is in exactly one bucket: exposed with its distribution summary, or refused with a reason. silently_missing must be 0.

simulation.ranking_basis: Only families with a non-zero DEPLOYED reconciliation weight are ranked. At weight 0 the reconciled mean IS the market mean, so any remaining gap against the mid comes from the football shape, which has never been confirmed out of sample; those rows are listed under unranked_zero_weight_disagreements and carry no authority. A row whose reconciled gap points the OPPOSITE way to its own football view is also not ranked -- the relocation crossed the mid, so the gap is the market-mean estimator rather than the model's opinion -- and is listed under earned_but_contradicts_football_view.
simulation.note: The simulation's football-only probability is shown for every priced market; only the RECONCILED probability -- the football distribution shrunk toward the market by a weight fitted out of sample on the 2025 archive -- is ranked, and only where such a weight exists.

shadow_v2.information_sync_default: SYNCHRONIZED -- a market row carries `information_sync` only when it is NOT synchronized, i.e. only when the model read information the market it is quoted against had not yet seen
shadow_v2.primary_arm_basis: BOARD_V2 owns every non-player family; DATA_PLAYER_V3 is the player arm that is an independent football view of the statistic (DATA_PLAYER_DIST, its defective predecessor, is primary only on snapshots written before v3 and is DISABLED). MARKET_PLAYER_DIST is reconstructed FROM the Kalshi ladder and the HYBRID arms blend the two: they are reported, flagged `market_derived`, and never promoted into the primary slot. Being primary says nothing about authority: every arm answer carries its production-eligibility status, and on the current evidence the MARKET is the better player-prop distribution.
shadow_v2.not_in_snapshot_reason: Shadow v2 prices the universe of the latest daily discovery run; a contract Kalshi opened after that run has no v2 row at this snapshot

simulation.distribution_quantiles_note: The football median is the simulation distribution's own quantile(0.50). An artifact written before sim-1.1.0 does not report quantiles at all; those rows say so rather than having a median inferred for them.

coverage.invariant: Every listed FULL-period player/stat group is in exactly one bucket: exposed with its distribution summary, or refused with a reason. silently_missing must be 0.

simulation.ranking_basis: Only families with a non-zero DEPLOYED reconciliation weight are ranked. At weight 0 the reconciled mean IS the market mean, so any remaining gap against the mid comes from the football shape, which has never been confirmed out of sample; those rows are listed under unranked_zero_weight_disagreements and carry no authority. A row whose reconciled gap points the OPPOSITE way to its own football view is also not ranked -- the relocation crossed the mid, so the gap is the market-mean estimator rather than the model's opinion -- and is listed under earned_but_contradicts_football_view.
simulation.note: The simulation's football-only probability is shown for every priced market; only the RECONCILED probability -- the football distribution shrunk toward the market by a weight fitted out of sample on the 2025 archive -- is ranked, and only where such a weight exists.

freshness.reason: the simulation priced this packet's own board

shadow_v2.information_sync_default: SYNCHRONIZED -- a market row carries `information_sync` only when it is NOT synchronized, i.e. only when the model read information the market it is quoted against had not yet seen
shadow_v2.primary_arm_basis: BOARD_V2 owns every non-player family; DATA_PLAYER_V3 is the player arm that is an independent football view of the statistic (DATA_PLAYER_DIST, its defective predecessor, is primary only on snapshots written before v3 and is DISABLED). MARKET_PLAYER_DIST is reconstructed FROM the Kalshi ladder and the HYBRID arms blend the two: they are reported, flagged `market_derived`, and never promoted into the primary slot. Being primary says nothing about authority: every arm answer carries its production-eligibility status, and on the current evidence the MARKET is the better player-prop distribution.
shadow_v2.not_in_snapshot_reason: Shadow v2 prices the universe of the latest daily discovery run; a contract Kalshi opened after that run has no v2 row at this snapshot
shadow_v2.authority: RESEARCH ONLY. Shadow v2 is not validated for real money and no probability here reaches recommendation, staking or preflight.

key_questions: Tom Kennedy (WR, DET) is ruled out. Is the market's price on his replacement's usage already reflecting the redistributed role, or still anchored to a committee?

KXNFLGAME-26NOV01MINDET-DET moved +0.125 since first capture. Is that move explained by public injury news already in this packet, or is it information we do not have?

The model disagrees by -0.033 on KXNFLTOTAL-26NOV01MINDET-50 (TOTAL). Is that a mean disagreement the market has historically handled better, or a genuine shape difference? Note the model was shown redundant to the market on player props.

The model disagrees by +0.031 on KXNFLTEAMTOTAL-26NOV01MINDET-MIN4 (TEAM_TOTAL). Is that a mean disagreement the market has historically handled better, or a genuine shape difference? Note the model was shown redundant to the market on player props.

KXNFLTEAMTOTAL-26NOV01MINDET-MIN4 sits at a market price of 0.96 — a tail rung. The tail of the model's distribution is the least validated part of it. Is this rung relying on shape the model is known to miscalibrate?

simulation.distribution_quantiles_note: The football median is the simulation distribution's own quantile(0.50). An artifact written before sim-1.1.0 does not report quantiles at all; those rows say so rather than having a median inferred for them.

coverage.invariant: Every listed FULL-period player/stat group is in exactly one bucket: exposed with its distribution summary, or refused with a reason. silently_missing must be 0.

simulation.ranking_basis: Only families with a non-zero DEPLOYED reconciliation weight are ranked. At weight 0 the reconciled mean IS the market mean, so any remaining gap against the mid comes from the football shape, which has never been confirmed out of sample; those rows are listed under unranked_zero_weight_disagreements and carry no authority. A row whose reconciled gap points the OPPOSITE way to its own football view is also not ranked -- the relocation crossed the mid, so the gap is the market-mean estimator rather than the model's opinion -- and is listed under earned_but_contradicts_football_view.
simulation.note: The simulation's football-only probability is shown for every priced market; only the RECONCILED probability -- the football distribution shrunk toward the market by a weight fitted out of sample on the 2025 archive -- is ranked, and only where such a weight exists.

shadow_v2.information_sync_default: SYNCHRONIZED -- a market row carries `information_sync` only when it is NOT synchronized, i.e. only when the model read information the market it is quoted against had not yet seen
shadow_v2.primary_arm_basis: BOARD_V2 owns every non-player family; DATA_PLAYER_V3 is the player arm that is an independent football view of the statistic (DATA_PLAYER_DIST, its defective predecessor, is primary only on snapshots written before v3 and is DISABLED). MARKET_PLAYER_DIST is reconstructed FROM the Kalshi ladder and the HYBRID arms blend the two: they are reported, flagged `market_derived`, and never promoted into the primary slot. Being primary says nothing about authority: every arm answer carries its production-eligibility status, and on the current evidence the MARKET is the better player-prop distribution.
shadow_v2.not_in_snapshot_reason: Shadow v2 prices the universe of the latest daily discovery run; a contract Kalshi opened after that run has no v2 row at this snapshot

simulation.distribution_quantiles_note: The football median is the simulation distribution's own quantile(0.50). An artifact written before sim-1.1.0 does not report quantiles at all; those rows say so rather than having a median inferred for them.

coverage.invariant: Every listed FULL-period player/stat group is in exactly one bucket: exposed with its distribution summary, or refused with a reason. silently_missing must be 0.

simulation.ranking_basis: Only families with a non-zero DEPLOYED reconciliation weight are ranked. At weight 0 the reconciled mean IS the market mean, so any remaining gap against the mid comes from the football shape, which has never been confirmed out of sample; those rows are listed under unranked_zero_weight_disagreements and carry no authority. A row whose reconciled gap points the OPPOSITE way to its own football view is also not ranked -- the relocation crossed the mid, so the gap is the market-mean estimator rather than the model's opinion -- and is listed under earned_but_contradicts_football_view.
simulation.note: The simulation's football-only probability is shown for every priced market; only the RECONCILED probability -- the football distribution shrunk toward the market by a weight fitted out of sample on the 2025 archive -- is ranked, and only where such a weight exists.

shadow_v2.information_sync_default: SYNCHRONIZED -- a market row carries `information_sync` only when it is NOT synchronized, i.e. only when the model read information the market it is quoted against had not yet seen
shadow_v2.primary_arm_basis: BOARD_V2 owns every non-player family; DATA_PLAYER_V3 is the player arm that is an independent football view of the statistic (DATA_PLAYER_DIST, its defective predecessor, is primary only on snapshots written before v3 and is DISABLED). MARKET_PLAYER_DIST is reconstructed FROM the Kalshi ladder and the HYBRID arms blend the two: they are reported, flagged `market_derived`, and never promoted into the primary slot. Being primary says nothing about authority: every arm answer carries its production-eligibility status, and on the current evidence the MARKET is the better player-prop distribution.
shadow_v2.not_in_snapshot_reason: Shadow v2 prices the universe of the latest daily discovery run; a contract Kalshi opened after that run has no v2 row at this snapshot

simulation.distribution_quantiles_note: The football median is the simulation distribution's own quantile(0.50). An artifact written before sim-1.1.0 does not report quantiles at all; those rows say so rather than having a median inferred for them.

coverage.invariant: Every listed FULL-period player/stat group is in exactly one bucket: exposed with its distribution summary, or refused with a reason. silently_missing must be 0.

simulation.ranking_basis: Only families with a non-zero DEPLOYED reconciliation weight are ranked. At weight 0 the reconciled mean IS the market mean, so any remaining gap against the mid comes from the football shape, which has never been confirmed out of sample; those rows are listed under unranked_zero_weight_disagreements and carry no authority. A row whose reconciled gap points the OPPOSITE way to its own football view is also not ranked -- the relocation crossed the mid, so the gap is the market-mean estimator rather than the model's opinion -- and is listed under earned_but_contradicts_football_view.
simulation.note: The simulation's football-only probability is shown for every priced market; only the RECONCILED probability -- the football distribution shrunk toward the market by a weight fitted out of sample on the 2025 archive -- is ranked, and only where such a weight exists.

shadow_v2.information_sync_default: SYNCHRONIZED -- a market row carries `information_sync` only when it is NOT synchronized, i.e. only when the model read information the market it is quoted against had not yet seen
shadow_v2.primary_arm_basis: BOARD_V2 owns every non-player family; DATA_PLAYER_V3 is the player arm that is an independent football view of the statistic (DATA_PLAYER_DIST, its defective predecessor, is primary only on snapshots written before v3 and is DISABLED). MARKET_PLAYER_DIST is reconstructed FROM the Kalshi ladder and the HYBRID arms blend the two: they are reported, flagged `market_derived`, and never promoted into the primary slot. Being primary says nothing about authority: every arm answer carries its production-eligibility status, and on the current evidence the MARKET is the better player-prop distribution.

simulation.distribution_quantiles_note: The football median is the simulation distribution's own quantile(0.50). An artifact written before sim-1.1.0 does not report quantiles at all; those rows say so rather than having a median inferred for them.

coverage.invariant: Every listed FULL-period player/stat group is in exactly one bucket: exposed with its distribution summary, or refused with a reason. silently_missing must be 0.

simulation.ranking_basis: Only families with a non-zero DEPLOYED reconciliation weight are ranked. At weight 0 the reconciled mean IS the market mean, so any remaining gap against the mid comes from the football shape, which has never been confirmed out of sample; those rows are listed under unranked_zero_weight_disagreements and carry no authority. A row whose reconciled gap points the OPPOSITE way to its own football view is also not ranked -- the relocation crossed the mid, so the gap is the market-mean estimator rather than the model's opinion -- and is listed under earned_but_contradicts_football_view.
simulation.note: The simulation's football-only probability is shown for every priced market; only the RECONCILED probability -- the football distribution shrunk toward the market by a weight fitted out of sample on the 2025 archive -- is ranked, and only where such a weight exists.

freshness.reason: the simulation priced this packet's own board

shadow_v2.information_sync_default: SYNCHRONIZED -- a market row carries `information_sync` only when it is NOT synchronized, i.e. only when the model read information the market it is quoted against had not yet seen
shadow_v2.primary_arm_basis: BOARD_V2 owns every non-player family; DATA_PLAYER_V3 is the player arm that is an independent football view of the statistic (DATA_PLAYER_DIST, its defective predecessor, is primary only on snapshots written before v3 and is DISABLED). MARKET_PLAYER_DIST is reconstructed FROM the Kalshi ladder and the HYBRID arms blend the two: they are reported, flagged `market_derived`, and never promoted into the primary slot. Being primary says nothing about authority: every arm answer carries its production-eligibility status, and on the current evidence the MARKET is the better player-prop distribution.
shadow_v2.not_in_snapshot_reason: Shadow v2 prices the universe of the latest daily discovery run; a contract Kalshi opened after that run has no v2 row at this snapshot

simulation.distribution_quantiles_note: The football median is the simulation distribution's own quantile(0.50). An artifact written before sim-1.1.0 does not report quantiles at all; those rows say so rather than having a median inferred for them.

coverage.invariant: Every listed FULL-period player/stat group is in exactly one bucket: exposed with its distribution summary, or refused with a reason. silently_missing must be 0.

simulation.ranking_basis: Only families with a non-zero DEPLOYED reconciliation weight are ranked. At weight 0 the reconciled mean IS the market mean, so any remaining gap against the mid comes from the football shape, which has never been confirmed out of sample; those rows are listed under unranked_zero_weight_disagreements and carry no authority. A row whose reconciled gap points the OPPOSITE way to its own football view is also not ranked -- the relocation crossed the mid, so the gap is the market-mean estimator rather than the model's opinion -- and is listed under earned_but_contradicts_football_view.
simulation.note: The simulation's football-only probability is shown for every priced market; only the RECONCILED probability -- the football distribution shrunk toward the market by a weight fitted out of sample on the 2025 archive -- is ranked, and only where such a weight exists.

shadow_v2.information_sync_default: SYNCHRONIZED -- a market row carries `information_sync` only when it is NOT synchronized, i.e. only when the model read information the market it is quoted against had not yet seen
shadow_v2.primary_arm_basis: BOARD_V2 owns every non-player family; DATA_PLAYER_V3 is the player arm that is an independent football view of the statistic (DATA_PLAYER_DIST, its defective predecessor, is primary only on snapshots written before v3 and is DISABLED). MARKET_PLAYER_DIST is reconstructed FROM the Kalshi ladder and the HYBRID arms blend the two: they are reported, flagged `market_derived`, and never promoted into the primary slot. Being primary says nothing about authority: every arm answer carries its production-eligibility status, and on the current evidence the MARKET is the better player-prop distribution.
shadow_v2.not_in_snapshot_reason: Shadow v2 prices the universe of the latest daily discovery run; a contract Kalshi opened after that run has no v2 row at this snapshot

simulation.distribution_quantiles_note: The football median is the simulation distribution's own quantile(0.50). An artifact written before sim-1.1.0 does not report quantiles at all; those rows say so rather than having a median inferred for them.

coverage.invariant: Every listed FULL-period player/stat group is in exactly one bucket: exposed with its distribution summary, or refused with a reason. silently_missing must be 0.

simulation.ranking_basis: Only families with a non-zero DEPLOYED reconciliation weight are ranked. At weight 0 the reconciled mean IS the market mean, so any remaining gap against the mid comes from the football shape, which has never been confirmed out of sample; those rows are listed under unranked_zero_weight_disagreements and carry no authority. A row whose reconciled gap points the OPPOSITE way to its own football view is also not ranked -- the relocation crossed the mid, so the gap is the market-mean estimator rather than the model's opinion -- and is listed under earned_but_contradicts_football_view.
simulation.note: The simulation's football-only probability is shown for every priced market; only the RECONCILED probability -- the football distribution shrunk toward the market by a weight fitted out of sample on the 2025 archive -- is ranked, and only where such a weight exists.

freshness.reason: the simulation priced this packet's own board

shadow_v2.information_sync_default: SYNCHRONIZED -- a market row carries `information_sync` only when it is NOT synchronized, i.e. only when the model read information the market it is quoted against had not yet seen
shadow_v2.primary_arm_basis: BOARD_V2 owns every non-player family; DATA_PLAYER_V3 is the player arm that is an independent football view of the statistic (DATA_PLAYER_DIST, its defective predecessor, is primary only on snapshots written before v3 and is DISABLED). MARKET_PLAYER_DIST is reconstructed FROM the Kalshi ladder and the HYBRID arms blend the two: they are reported, flagged `market_derived`, and never promoted into the primary slot. Being primary says nothing about authority: every arm answer carries its production-eligibility status, and on the current evidence the MARKET is the better player-prop distribution.
shadow_v2.not_in_snapshot_reason: Shadow v2 prices the universe of the latest daily discovery run; a contract Kalshi opened after that run has no v2 row at this snapshot
shadow_v2.authority: RESEARCH ONLY. Shadow v2 is not validated for real money and no probability here reaches recommendation, staking or preflight.

B.meaning: coherent / Shadow research model view available

C.meaning: no automated pricing authority; handicap from the football and context data in this packet

D.meaning: cannot defensibly price -- explicit PASS / RESEARCH REQUIRED, with a reason

-.meaning: outside the pregame window (kickoff has passed)

!.meaning: INVARIANT VIOLATION -- a listed contract with no analysis state

coverage.invariant: silently_omitted must be 0: every listed contract carries exactly one analysis state

disagreement_ranking_basis.note: Markets wider than the cap, and untraded 0.00/0.99 books, are present in `markets` but never ranked -- their midpoint is a quoting artefact. Without this filter the top of every disagreement list is a book nobody has traded.
